Reservation Privacy Policy

Reservation form and optional SMS program · Effective November 19, 2026

Seafood Huntsville 888 LLC, doing business as The Juicy Seafood & Bar in Huntsville, Alabama, uses the information described below to manage restaurant reservations and optional reservation text messages. This policy applies to this reservation service.

Information we collect

The reservation form collects your name, party size, reservation date and time, phone number or email address, and any optional note you provide. If you choose SMS reminders, we record your consent, the associated mobile number, and the time of consent. The service also processes message delivery information and replies such as CONFIRM, HERE, HELP, and STOP.

How information is used

We use reservation information to process your booking, plan seating, communicate about your visit, and handle your requests. If you opt in to SMS, we use your mobile number to send reservation reminders and related responses. We use delivery, consent, and opt-out records to operate the messaging program and respect your choices.

Service providers and SMS privacy

Our reservation, hosting, and messaging service providers process information needed to store bookings and deliver communications on our behalf. They do not receive permission from us to use your information for their own marketing.

We do not sell or rent your mobile number. Mobile information is not shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. SMS consent is specific to this restaurant's reservation messaging program and is not sold, transferred, or shared with other businesses for their messaging programs.

All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information won't be shared with any third parties.

Your choices

SMS is optional. You may leave the SMS consent checkbox unchecked and still make a reservation. Reply STOP to stop text messages, or HELP for assistance. Opting out of SMS does not cancel your reservation.

To request a correction or deletion of reservation information, contact our host team. We may need to retain certain records to honor opt-outs or meet applicable obligations.
